concerns.text: FR-008 (independent Oracle Policy Engine) is implemented (T002) but there is no task that verifies the Oracle’s independence from the compression modules, violating Constitution VI.
SC-005 (total compute‑time measurement on the GitHub Actions runner) is not covered by any task; no task records wall‑clock time or validates it against the free‑tier limit.

The plan lists 27 implementation tasks (e.g., T‑Gen‑Deterministic, T‑Oracle‑Independent, T‑Compress‑BFSDFS, T‑Tokenizer‑Wrapper, T‑Exec‑Full, T‑Exec‑Compressed, T‑Prepare‑Step‑Level‑Data, T‑Analyze‑GEE, T‑Analyze‑Trend, T‑Analyze‑Bootstrap, T‑Monotonicity‑Check, T‑Power‑Simulation, T‑Invalid‑Exclusion‑Report, T‑Analyze‑Results‑Schema, T‑Report‑Artifacts, T‑Tests‑Unit, T‑Tests‑Integration, T‑Doc‑Quickstart, T‑Contract‑Schemas, T‑Update‑Final‑State, T‑Verify‑Invalid‑Exclusion, T‑Generate‑Reproducibility‑Report, T‑Main‑Pipeline, T‑Abort‑On‑Threshold, T‑Adapt‑Generator‑Adaptive, T‑Validate‑Tradeoff‑CSV, T‑Generate‑Figure) but none of these identifiers appear in tasks.md. Consequently the plan elements have no documented tasks.
No task records checksums for raw/processed/result files and updates the project‑state YAML as required by Constitution III and V (e.g., a “T‑Update‑Final‑State” task).
Task T‑Validate‑Tradeoff‑CSV, which validates `tradeoff_curve.csv` against its schema, is missing from tasks.md, risking violation of Constitution IV (single source of truth).
